reload_SentenceEmbedder: reload a pretrained SentenceEmbedder model from a checkpoint path and params
get_embeddings: get single-vector sentence embeddings from tokenized input tensors using the embedder
get_parameters: get trainable parameters for a specified layer range of the transformer model
train_SentenceEmbedder: set the SentenceEmbedder model to training mode for fine-tuning
eval_SentenceEmbedder: set the SentenceEmbedder model to evaluation mode for inference
